title: Area, units and persons keys in one period, move-in mid-year, vacant unit counts as one person
reviewNote: Invented case, calculated by hand by the developer. Not checked by a property manager or lawyer. Same case as apps/api/src/modules/settlement/assemble.test.ts.
calculation: Period 2026 has 365 days. Unit U2 is vacant for 181 days and let to O2 from 1 July (184 days).

k1 insurance 1000.00 by area 60 : 40 -> U1 600.00, U2 400.00. U2 by days: 40000 * 184/365 = 20164.38 (remainder 140), * 181/365 = 19835.62 (remainder 225). Floors sum to 39999, the cent goes to the larger remainder: O2 20164, vacancy 19836.
k2 waste 365.00 by units -> 182.50 each. U2 by days: 18250 * 184/365 = 9200 exactly, vacancy 9050.
k3 water 730.00 by persons and days, a vacant unit counts as 1 person: O1 2*365 = 730, O2 1*184 = 184, vacancy U1 0, vacancy U2 1*181 = 181, total 1095.

73000 * 730/1095 = 48666.67, * 184/1095 = 12266.67, * 181/1095 = 12066.67, all with remainder 730. Floors sum to 72998; the two cents go to the earliest entries O1 and O2: O1 48667, O2 12267, vacancy 12066.
